# Deep Agents memory: StateBackend, StoreBackend and filesystem

Honest caveats: requires the `deepagents` package; production persistence needs `PostgresStore` — `InMemoryStore` is lost on restart; and the skill itself warns: never use FilesystemBackend in web servers, use StateBackend or a sandbox instead.
